sentences.text: Aglais io is an insect in the order Lepidoptera.
In Mainz-Bingen, 625 reports over ten years show a main time of Mar–Apr, Jun–Jul and Sep.
It has been recorded eating Stinging Nettle, English Ivy, Hemp Agrimony and Hop.
Goldenrod Crab Spider is recorded as a predator.
It has been recorded visiting flowers of Creeping Thistle, Hemp Agrimony, common dandelion and Blackthorn.
